subject: general
question: Which day is observed as Armed Forces Flag Day across all colleges in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**7th December**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Armed Forces Flag Day** is observed across India on **7th December** every year.
 
• The day is dedicated to honoring the soldiers, airmen, and sailors of India who serve the nation.
 
• Funds are collected on this day through the distribution of flags and stickers to the public.
 
• The funds raised are used for the welfare of the Armed Forces personnel.
 
• The day was first observed in 1949 and has since become an annual tradition.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Armed Forces Flag Day Fund** was set up to manage the collection and distribution of funds for the welfare of the armed forces personnel and their families.
 
• Various welfare programs are funded by these contributions, including rehabilitation of battle casualties, welfare of serving personnel and their families, and resettlement and welfare of ex-servicemen and their families.
 
• On this day, the general public and volunteers participate in the collection of funds by distributing token flags, badges, and other items.
 
• The Ministry of Defence plays a significant role in organizing the events and activities associated with Armed Forces Flag Day.
 
• It is an opportunity for citizens to express their gratitude and appreciation for the sacrifices made by the armed forces personnel.
